description: Use this when you only need how the dealer regime changed during one past trading day: a compressed list of regime segments with their start and end times. For the full intraday structure (walls, gamma flip, net GEX, spot) use get_day instead. One replay date (YYYY-MM-DD) per call.

date.description: Replay date in YYYY-MM-DD; use list_history_dates for the set of valid dates.

name: get_regime_segments
title: Regime Segment Tape
